description: Steady base flow of the Re = 100 cylinder wake by Dynamic Mode Tracking (userParam01 = 1.3, omega_c = 0.7337, beta = 1, chi = 0.5). The run stops when the residual (root mean square over the domain of u - ubar divided by the time step) falls below userParam15 = 1e-7; the last row of residu_dmt.dat must lie below it. The converged field is the steady flow of the Newton solution of 210_baseflow_newton (the four statistics below are the Newton values, within 4e-5 of this run).

final_residual.note: Residual of the last step; it must lie below the gate userParam15 = 1e-7, which stops the run.

convergence_time.note: Time at which the gate is met, in convective time units. Measured on Jean Zay.
